translations.web: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
translations.bsb: Surely you will be ashamed of the sacred oaks in which you have delighted; you will be embarrassed by the gardens that you have chosen.
